evidence.quote: So this um, this sort of Hutsu mark from Motua the the jaguar growls, and actually well, first, the jaguar turns to to Izzarak and says, you have done well to keep open the door to this place that I could travel through. Thank you.
Enari returns to the lizardfolk village to report back on what's happened and tell them things are safe. Izzarak um establish... It begins to sort of figure out how he will help heal the land.

markers.note: The closing montage gives the region, not a new precise camp or dwelling.

markers.reading: Lengau sends Kenzo directly to the Feywild clifftop at Lastlight Falls, in ruined Amberglow.

evidence.quote: Um, so where are you telling, uh, Lengau, that you want to go?
I know the crossing you speak of. That is Lastlight Falls. Cliff, a spring at the top, falling in rainbow colors. The Feywild.
I don't.

markers.note: The arrival side is settled explicitly as the Feywild; no crossing from the material plane is played.
